title: Do you have to be sore to grow? 😣
caption:
Soreness mostly shows up when something is new, and fades fast when you repeat the workout, but growth continues. It is not a good measure of progress. Track your weights and reps instead. Sore today? 👇

Gym Myths Busted #6
first_comment: Rate your soreness today from 1 (fine) to 10 (stairs are my enemy) 👇
